reviews.review:
Right, where to begin...

This is the worst hockey game I have ever played. In my age, I have played over 23 games of the NHL franchise and 2K franchise combined and I have never ever seen such a mess of a game.

This game heavily mentions "you should use a controller", you know what doesn't support a controller? The main menu. Amazing start.

So let's go through what the game does:
-Player Customization.
-Practice Mode, this allows you to skate around a ring with NO NPCs but allows you to test your controls.
-It allegedly allows you to play online, if it does work or not, who knows. I was trying to get a game for 30minutes and I got nothing. Then checked the player count of this game and saw that this game is dead, like literally there was 0 people online for the past 9hours.
-Most over complicated control scheme I have ever seen.
-Control Instructions are an absolute mess and just a bob of text on your screen during practice.

What the game doesn't do:
-Have a offline match.
-No NPC/Bots.
-No Career mode.
-No Create your team.
-No quick match.
-No Penalty Shootout.
-No Players.
-Fair pricing model.

So I then looked into their discord for several hours and found the following:
-Devs and Mods are constantly deleting and banning people from discord that provide criticism.
-Devs and Mods then spin the narrative around as "they are disrespectful", which works because they deleted and banned the person that writes it, so people have no visibility of what real happened and get manipulated by the devs.
-Devs claim it took them 5 years to build this game. Considering there's only 1 game mode and I can't even access it due to lack of players. Great. Love the content. Maybe in another 5 years we will have offline with bots?
-Devs and Members of the community constantly claim this 25$ title has more value than a $70 EA NHL Game.
If you look at the above list of what content the game contains and doesn't contain, I would take the EA game anytime for 70$.

So in short, this game is not worth the price tag, it should at best be 5$ for what it offers. That's assuming the devs were worth supporting. Their behaviour makes me remember devs like YandereDev, which have no idea what they are doing and are delusional about their own product. Get offended by anything that isn't strictly positive and will ban you out of their discord for providing criticism.

A big no from me. A buyer deserver better for 25$, this is embarrassing.

EDIT 3rd November: 24hour peak - 1 Player.
You know what's the funniest part, in all of this "Dev Response"? The only thing they bothered to comment is on the fact that I forgot to change the account I was logged in to reply to Marsamune. Not at all to defend the game or promise improvements or that they are working on feedback. NOPE, it's pin point that I accidentally responded to another person with the wrong account. I mean, if the review itself wasn't enough of an indicator of their delusional ego, I think this tops the cake.

EDIT: 7th November: Game with 0 players for 6 out 7 days in a week.
Devs still got nothing better to do than pointing out the alias. I'm clearly in their head. To alleviate their PTSD about the honest review, I have changed the account's name to FioX, for now. Until the time I need to use the account again when my partner or daughter wants to play Stardew Valley on my main and I want to play CS2 at the same time. If only the game had family sharing. Now that the name matches the one in the comment, surely the devs will now fix and address the issues the game has. Right? I can't be screwed to keep track of updates of this game, as it's clearly dead. So even if the devs come with another excuse for this review, in.... likely 4 days time. I won't bother to address it. Already refunded this nonsense anyway.

In the end, the playerbase count shows the story:
https://steamdb.info/app/1024820/charts/

The game is crap. Everyone can see it, otherwise they would be playing the game.
